title: Benchmark Validity Repair (1a diagnostic) + Non-Circular Skeleton (1b)

phase_1a_diagnostic.interpretation: Per-type circularity is severe: demographic_conflict (largest anomaly class) is 0.94-recoverable by a single sex-specific-token indicator (the same token family the ontology rule flags), and medication_mismatch is 0.72-recoverable by sequence length. Only missing_diagnosis (0.56) is mildly trivial. Any detection/ontology result on this benchmark is not A*-defensible.

phase_1b_skeleton.ontology_logic_status: not_implemented_by_design; guarded with NotImplementedError until Phase 2 (real SNOMED/RxNorm). No fake medical logic added.

next_phase: Phase 2 — Real Ontology Integration (acquire UMLS/SNOMED/RxNorm, run existing parsers, consolidate the two ontology subsystems, wire real ontology into scoring, produce coverage report). Phase 1b ontology-backed anomaly v2 injectors are then implemented on top of that ontology.
